$comment: Regression guard for CI: thresholds sit just below the measured results so changes cannot silently degrade detection. Top-level keys gate Path A (npm run bench:gate); "pathB" gates the shipped tagger (npm run bench:gate -- --path-b). Blueprint targets (F2 >= 0.97, FPR < 0.05%) are reported separately as targets in the Workbench; they are not yet met on held-out data.
